cardboard.tip: Flatten boxes and keep them dry. Remove tape and packing material. Greasy or wet cardboard (e.g. pizza box) is not recyclable.

glass.tip: Rinse bottles and jars, remove caps. Do not mix with ceramics, mirrors or window glass. Wrap broken glass safely.

metal.tip: Rinse cans and foil. Empty aerosol cans only if fully empty. Scrap metal can go to a local scrap dealer.

paper.tip: Keep paper clean and dry. Tissues, paper towels and waxed or laminated paper are not recyclable.

plastic.tip: Rinse, remove caps and labels, and crush bottles. Check the resin code; thin films and bags often need special drop-off.

trash.tip: Not recyclable. Put in general waste. Hazardous items (batteries, e-waste, medical) need special collection points.
